description.value: LiquorForLess is a discount liquor retail chain with six locations across the Fraser Valley, positioning itself as priced below government liquor stores with a large selection of beer, wine, and spirits. The Langley outlet sits in a strip-mall unit at 216th Street and Fraser Highway, adjacent to a Starbucks. The chain has been voted Favourite Liquor Store and Favourite Winery/Wine Store by local voters, making it a recognizable regional stop for touring cyclists looking to stock up on beverages.
